_about: Ground truth for public YouTube tune-up videos, read by pipeline.py (stage strikes). Per video: where the chakra of each bowl comes from, how the strike times are derived, and how far to trust both. Chakras: root, sacral, solar_plexus, heart, throat, third_eye, crown. Times in seconds of the video. Collected 26.10.2026 from the videos' own chapter lists, descriptions and YouTube's automatic captions (read, not stored).

-ar9vsmFhJU.title: 11 MIN QUICK CHAKRA TUNE-UP (#1) W/LONG SINGLE TONES
-ar9vsmFhJU.chakra_source: the description's chapter list (00:53 Root Chakra ... 09:55 Crown Chakra, 11:43 all 7 bowls together) and 'Each bowl is struck 3 times', root to crown
-ar9vsmFhJU.strike_source: derived: the 3 strongest spectral-flux onsets in each chapter, at least 4 s apart
-ar9vsmFhJU.reliability: chakra high (the player's own chapter titles); strike times medium (the count of 3 is stated, the times are not)
-ar9vsmFhJU.note: the 'root' bowl rings at G#3 (208 Hz): by note the app reads it as Throat. The intended chakra is scored, as a person in the room would.

u1KjQTAHSlo.title: 7 Chakra Tibetan Singing Bowl Set | Individual Notes & Harmonic Sound Test
u1KjQTAHSlo.chakra_source: YouTube's automatic captions: before each bowl the seller says 'This is the crown chakra singing bowl tuned to note B', then third eye (A) down to root (C); the description lists the same notes
u1KjQTAHSlo.strike_source: derived: the strongest spectral-flux onset between 1.5 s after the announcement (the sentence) and the next announcement
u1KjQTAHSlo.reliability: chakra high (spoken by the seller, matches the description); strike times medium (one strike per bowl assumed; a bowl struck twice is scored at its strongest strike)

CPlC2404Ils.title: 7 Chakra Tibetan Singing Bowl Set | Individual Notes & Harmonic Sound Test
CPlC2404Ils.evidence: the same recording under another channel: the detector gives the same segments with the same frequencies, shifted by 1.7 s; the captions announce the same bowls 1.4 to 1.8 s later. Counted once, as u1KjQTAHSlo, everywhere.

8Qhh2VF1Oz4.title: Crystal Bowl 14 min Chakra Meditation~Notes CDEFGAB
8Qhh2VF1Oz4.chakra_source: the description ('the tones 1 by 1 ... starting from the Root Chakra and going up to the Crown') and the chapters 'Crystal Bowl #3' to '#7'; chapter '#1' (25 to 292 s) holds bowls 1 and 2 and is left out
8Qhh2VF1Oz4.strike_source: none: crystal bowls are rung on, not struck; only the share of each chapter's time with the intended colour is scored
8Qhh2VF1Oz4.reliability: chakra medium (bowl number read as chakra number, as the description says)
